+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, nil), types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+// isAuthMethod checks an authentication method against a readable policy label.
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	method, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+
+	var expected auth.Method
+	switch string(method) {
+	case "token":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN
+	case "oidc":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC
+	case "kubernetes", "k8s":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES
+	case "github":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB
+	case "jwt":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_JWT
+	case "cloud":
+		expected = auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(method))
+	}
+
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	actual := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(expected)))), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method auth.Method
+	}{
+		{"token", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{"oidc", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{"kubernetes", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"k8s", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"github", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{"jwt", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{"cloud", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{
+				ast.StringTerm("authentication"),
+				ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(int(tt.method))}),
+			})
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)
+
+			other := ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{
+				ast.StringTerm("authentication"),
+				ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(int(auth.Method_METHOD_NONE))}),
+			})
+			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, other, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("password"))
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported auth method") && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "password"))
+}
